metric_scope: Unicode NFKC, remove Unicode punctuation categories P* and whitespace, then unit-cost character Levenshtein. No kana conversion, homophone substitution, target-conditioned correction or rewriting. Character differences, including kanji/kana spelling, are not proof of missing or mispronounced speech.
limits: ASR is auxiliary content evidence, not human listening, speaker identity, tone or naturalness acceptance.
One seed and one selected hot output for four Japanese texts per configuration; no multilingual or robustness claim.
ASR segment timestamps are unmodified decoder output, not phoneme or word alignment.
Reference and candidate text equality cannot establish that either generated all requested speech.
The FP32 replay pair and natural FP16 pair use different random-input mechanisms and generate different semantic sequences; cross-family differences cannot isolate GPT precision effects.
Candidate strict official-FP32 PCM failures are preserved in original TTS reports and are not waived by ASR text agreement.
